label: quote-only fixture, non-owned
purpose: Public example addresses taken from the official 1Click documentation, used only as recipient/refundTo in dry:true quote requests. They are not user wallets, never receive funds from this system, and no swap or deposit is ever submitted.

sources.sdk: https://github.com/defuse-protocol/one-click-sdk-typescript README Quick Start (comments: 'Valid Arbitrum address', 'Valid Solana Address'; fetched 2026-11-11)

eth.provenance: same EVM address as the official SDK/OpenAPI refundTo example; reused for Ethereum, Base and Arbitrum (one EVM key space)
eth.checkedAgainst: EIP-55 checksum verified 2026-11-11; accepted by the live 1Click dry quote API (see reports/TESTS/QUOTE-CLEANUP/validation-*.json)

base.checkedAgainst: EIP-55 checksum; live 1Click dry quote API

arb.provenance: official SDK README labels this exact string 'Valid Arbitrum address'
arb.checkedAgainst: EIP-55 checksum; live 1Click dry quote API

sol.provenance: official SDK README labels this exact string 'Valid Solana Address'; OpenAPI recipient example
sol.checkedAgainst: base58 decodes to 32 bytes; live 1Click dry quote API
